LanguageData.SSC_RomanceMood_C_A_S2_N_Name: Bound from courting: Stifled at heart
LanguageData.SSC_RomanceMood_C_A_S2_N_Description: Choosing to love, propose, or leave someone is no longer mine to do. The stifling feeling of bound hands and feet presses on my chest day after day.
LanguageData.SSC_RomanceMood_C_A_S2_M_Description: Restrictions on taking the first step in love leave some resentment. Yet when the chain checks that impulse, something indistinctly tingling mingles with the frustration.
LanguageData.SSC_RomanceMood_C_A_S3_N_Description: Taking that first step, loving whomever I choose, is no longer possible. In time, only a trace of loss remains, and a quiet acceptance of these rules.
LanguageData.SSC_RomanceMood_C_A_S3_M_Name: Bound from courting: A little sweetness
LanguageData.SSC_RomanceMood_C_A_S3_M_Description: My initiative in love is controlled, and I gradually stop resisting. The choices taken from me have begun to seep with obedient sweetness.
LanguageData.SSC_RomanceMood_C_A_S4_N_Description: It was never for me to initiate whom I love, seek, or leave. Trained completely, even the wish to take the first step has faded into gentle obedience.
LanguageData.SSC_RomanceMood_C_A_S4_M_Name: Bound from courting: Burning in bondage
LanguageData.SSC_RomanceMood_C_A_S4_M_Description: The chain has taken my initiative in love, yet the deprivation brings pleasure. Not even the wish to love is free; it makes me burn all over and feel deeply safe.
LanguageData.SSC_RomanceMood_C_B_S3_N_Name: Bound in response: A blocked heart
LanguageData.SSC_RomanceMood_C_B_S3_N_Description: Even whether to accept or refuse is no longer mine to decide. When someone brings their feelings to me, I can only follow the rules; my chest feels stuffed with cotton.
LanguageData.SSC_RomanceMood_C_B_S3_M_Name: Bound in response: Not a ripple
LanguageData.SSC_RomanceMood_C_B_S3_M_Description: Acceptance and refusal are both arranged for me, bringing neither joy nor sorrow. Accustomed to being controlled, I feel strangely still inside.
LanguageData.SSC_RomanceMood_C_B_S4_N_Description: Accepting or refusing is simply following the rules. This body has long stopped asking why; my heart is quiet, without much feeling either way.
LanguageData.SSC_RomanceMood_C_B_S4_M_Name: Bound in response: A faint heat
LanguageData.SSC_RomanceMood_C_B_S4_M_Description: Whom I accept or refuse is not mine to decide, yet this helplessness makes heat stir between my thighs. An arranged response has become another gently sweet obedience.
LanguageData.SSC_RomanceMood_C_AB_S3_N_Name: Bound beyond escape: Unable to breathe
LanguageData.SSC_RomanceMood_C_AB_S3_N_Description: I cannot take the first step in love or refuse another's love. The chain has bound both ends tight; I feel smothered in a cage, unable to breathe.
LanguageData.SSC_RomanceMood_C_AB_S3_M_Description: Both initiating and responding are tightly controlled, leaving my chest blocked. Yet when the chain tightens, an unmistakable tingle mingles with the frustration.
LanguageData.SSC_RomanceMood_C_AB_S4_N_Description: Loving and being loved are no longer mine to choose, and I have stopped struggling. This body has made being controlled instinctive; even my heart has grown obedient.
LanguageData.SSC_RomanceMood_C_AB_S4_M_Name: Bound beyond escape: Trembling in bondage
LanguageData.SSC_RomanceMood_C_AB_S4_M_Description: The chain has taken both initiative and response, yet complete bondage brings me bliss. Even the direction of love is no longer mine; it leaves my whole body tingling and trembling.
